overloads.semanticRole: The IMPORT STRUCTURE command imports, into the current database, the XML definition of the 4D database structure passed in the xmlStructure parameter.

constraints: If any imported table name collides with an existing table name in the current structure, an error is generated and the whole import is aborted.
Fails with an error if the current structure is compiled and/or read-only, and cannot be called from a 4D application running in remote mode.
